The '''Thirsty Monoc''' was a [[Cantina|bar]] owned by the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nim Abek]]. It was on level 3 of the [[Shadowport/Legends|Shadowport]] [[Abek's Station]].
